lightIdle: Thayipha noma yikuphi likheli lewebhusayithi. Sihlola luhlu lwetfu lwetinsongo, sakhiwo, kulingisa timphawu, i-DNS nemphendvulo lekhona nyalo. Ku-Misa: phuma, cinisekisa ngesiteshi lesisemtfweti losethembako, bese ubika uma utsandza.
lightLimited: Kuhle kusho kutsi kuhlola lokwentiwe akuzange kube nesexwayiso lesinamandla — akusona sithembiso sekutsi isayithi iphephile.
privacyNote: Lokuhlala kukhona: akugcinwa lutfo. Kuhlola emaphutsa kusita kulungisa tinkinga tebuchwepheshe kuphela — soze kube likheli, futsi soze kube kukhishwa emphakatsini.
privacyPolicyIntro: i-buusdo Cybersecurity Service Tool (umugca wemikhiqizo ye-Buusdo — umkhiqizo lohlukile) ikusita kutsi uhlola likheli lewebhusayithi ngaphambi kwekutsi ulithembe. Kuhlola kusetjentiswa timphawu tetfu uqobo neluhlu lwetfu lwetinsongo lolugcinwa. Leli likhasi yisaziso semfihlo semkhiqizo sewebhusayithi, i-extension yesiphequluli, ne-app yedeskithophu.
privacyPolicyWhatBody: Uma ucala kuhlola, likheli lolifakako licutjungulwa kuseva ye-buusdo kute kuhlaziywe sakhiwo, kufaniswe neluhlu lwetfu lwetinsongo, futsi ngekukhetsa kuhlolwe kufinyeleleka lokukhona nyalo (i-DNS / i-HTTP). Asithumeli ema-URL lahloliwe ku-Google Safe Browsing noma kwamanye ema-API edumela enkhampani yesitsatfu, futsi asithengisi idatha yekuhlola.
privacyPolicyStoreBody: Lokuhlala kukhona: akugcinwa lutfo. Ungakhetsa kugcina kule divayisi kuphela (luhlu lwekuvimbela/lwekuthemba, umlandvo wekuhlola longawukhetsa) kusiphequluli, ku-extension, noma ku-app yedeskithophu. Kuhlola emaphutsa kwekulekelela lokukhetsako kufaka umtfombo neluhlobo lwensongo kuphela — soze kube likheli leligcwele, futsi soze kube kukhishwa emphakatsini noma kukhangisa.
privacyPolicyAccountBody: i-buusdo ayiniki i-akhawunti yelifu noma kuvumelanisa kweluhlu emkhatsini wemadivayisi. Luhlu lwakho lwekuvimbela/lwekuthemba luhlala kule divayisi. Luhambise ngekukhipha/kungenisa i-JSON noma i-QR ye-shield-lists-v1, noma uvumelanise wena ifayela le-shield-backup.json yedeskithophu (i-USB, i-Drive, i-Syncthing).
privacyPolicyContactBody: Ngemibuto yemfihlo noma yemkhiqizo, xhumana nemsebeni wekumisa kwakho kwe-buusdo nge-imeyili yakhe lesemtfweti noma ngesiteshi sekulekelela (umuntfu noma inhlangano leqhuba i-Cloudflare Worker). Khetsa lelo likheli lesemtfweti loselati — hhayi lucingo noma i-imeyili leprintwe kusayithi loyihlolako. Unganamathiseli imiphumela yekuhlola lebucayi etiteshini temphakatsi.
privacyPolicyLimitsBody: Kute kukhishwa kwe-TLS — i-HTTPS CONNECT ligama lemshini kuphela; kute sitifiketi se-MITM. Kute kubulawa kwetinqubo — tinhlelo letisebentako tiyaqhubeka. Tinkhomba tesistimu tiyabikwa kuphela — /usr, /etc, tindlela tesistimu te-Windows, ne-Program Files atisoze tisuswe noma tihlelwe. Kute injini ye-AV noma yemasignesha, futsi kute kubanjwa kwemaphasewedi noma umlandvo wekuphequlula.
desktopDownloadsIntro: Faka i-buusdo kule khomphyutha kusuka ku-GitHub Release (igobolondo lesiphequluli + ithreyi). Takhiwo atisayiniwe — bheka umhlahlandlela wekusetha. Kuvula uma ungena kuhlala kucinyiwe kuze kube uyikhipha.
desktopDownloadUnsignedUntilPromote: Sakhiwo lesingasayiniwe (asinganotari). I-macOS ingavimbela kuvula kwekucala — landzela umhlahlandlela wekusetha (i-xattr / Privacy & Security). I-Windows SmartScreen ingaxwayisa ngoMshicileli longatiwa.
desktopDownloadReadyToPromote: Inotsi lelidzala: kukhushulwa lokunotariwe akusetjentiswa kule ndlela yekuthumela — gcina i-zip ye-GitHub lengasayiniwe njengeyekucala.
privacyDesktopMirrorNote: Kulayisha kwe-macOS yedeskithophu: sibuko se-CDN siyasebenta; i-GitHub Release ihlala iyindlela lebhalwe yekubuyela.
privacy: Lokuhlola kuhlala kule khomphyutha. Awugcinwa umlandvo wekubhrawuza.
invalid: Faka likheli lelivumelekile le-HTTP noma i-HTTPS.
ignoreRiskBody: Unganikeza emaphasewedi, imininingwane yekukhokha, noma lenye datha yemuntfu kuloyo lolawula leli kheli. Vala ithebhu ngaphambi kwekuthayipha noma kukhokha noma yini.
nextStepLeave: Phuma kuleli khasi nyalo — ungakuqhubeki ekhelini loliholile.
nextStepNoCredentials: Ungafaki emaphasewedi, tinombolo temakhadi, emakhodi e-SMS/imeyili, noma lenye datha yemuntfu kule sayithi.
nextStepVerifyOfficial: Cinisekisa ngekuzimela: vula isizinda noma i-app lesemtsetfweni yenhlangano losethembako (ibhukhimakhi, likhadi lebhanga, sitolo se-app lesatiwa). Ungasebentisi tifoni noma ema-imeyili akhona ekhasini lelisolisayo.
nextStepReport: Ngekukhetsa: gcina ngezasi umbhalo wesikhashana wendzawo kute umsebeni abuyekeze umshini weluhlu lwetinsongo lolugcinwa.
nextStepBlock: Ngekukhetsa: vimbela umshini ku-extension noma i-app yedeskithophu ye-buusdo kute kube lukhuni kuwuvula ngephutsa.
nextStepLooksReal: Emakhasi ekukhwabanisa avame kubukeka ahlanzekile futsi asebentise i-HTTPS. Ikhwalithi yekubukeka ayifakazeli kutsi isayithi isemtsetfweni.
honestLimitNoWipe: I-buusdo ayikwati kusula lwati lwemuntfu iwebhusayithi leseyiluqoqile. Shintja emaphasewedi kusayithi yangempela lesemtsetfweni uma ufake noma yini, bese ubheka tixwayiso tebhanga/imeyili.
honestLimitNoCrowd: Imiphumela ivela eluhlwini lolugcinwa kanye netimphawu telikheli te-buusdo — hhayi sibalo semphakatsi sekutsi bangaki bantfu lababike isayithi.
honestLimitNoAv: Lena akusiyo imkhiqizo yekulwa nemagciwane. Kuvala ithebhu kumisa kufaka datha lapha; ayiskeni noma ihlanze idivayisi yakho.
actionSensitiveNote: Ungafaki lwati lolubucayi ngaphandle kwekutsi unakucinisekisa likheli ngemtfombo lozimele.
feedbackReportExportHint: Umbhalo wesikhashana ugciniwe. Vula Tinhlelo → Imibhalo yesikhashana yempendvulo kute ukhiphe ifayela le-batches/*.json kute umsebeni abuyekeze — kute lokuthunyelwako.
faqNoWipeTitle: Ingabe i-buusdo ingasula idatha isayithi leseyiyitfole?
faqNoWipeBody: Cha. Shintja emaphasewedi kusayithi yangempela lesemtfweti uma kufakwe lutfo, bese ubheka tixwayiso tebhanga noma te-imeyili.
faqNoAvBody: Cha. Kuvala ithebhu kumisa kufaka idatha lokwengeziwe kulelo likheli; akuskeni noma kuhlanze idivayisi.
faqNoCrowdTitle: Ingabe emaphuzu avela etivotini talabanye basebentisi?
faqNoCrowdBody: Cha. Imiphumela isebentisa luhlu lwetinsongo lolugcinwa lwe-buusdo netimphawu telikheli — hhayi sibalo semphakatsi sekutsi bangaki bantfu lababike loku.
protection: Sebentisa i-extension noma i-app yedeskithophu kute ubuyekeze luhlu lwekuvikela.
currentlyBlocked: ivinjelwe ku-extension noma ku-app yedeskithophu uma uyengeza lapho.
resetDone: Umlandvo wendzawo, imibhalo yesikhashana, nekhiye yeluhlu lelidzala kusuliwe.
blockListsWebsiteNote: Le webhusayithi ayiphoqeleli luhlu lwekuvimbela/lwekuthemba (i-extension nedeskithophu kuyenta loko). Luhlu luhlala kudivayisi.
blockListsOfflinePath: Indlela emkhatsini wemadivayisi: khipha noma ngenisa i-JSON noma i-QR ye-shield-lists-v1 ku-extension noma ku-app yedeskithophu. Ideskithophu ingavumelanisa ne-shield-backup.json nge-USB, i-Drive, noma i-Syncthing — kute akhawunti yelifu.
listsOfflineIntro: Luhlu lwekuvimbela nelwekuthemba luhlala kudivayisi ngayinye. Kute akhawunti yelifu ye-buusdo. Sebentisa kukhupha/kungenisa noma kuvumelanisa kwefayela.
listsOfflineStepExport: Ku-extension noma ku-app yedeskithophu, khipha i-shield-lists-v1 (i-JSON noma i-QR).
listsOfflineStepMove: Kopisha ifayela noma skena i-QR kudivayisi lenye (i-USB, i-Drive, umlayeto lowutithumela wona).
listsOfflineStepImport: Ngenisa kudivayisi lenye. Kungcono umbhali munye ngesikhatsi.
listsOfflineDesktopBody: I-app yedeskithophu igcina luhlu njenge-shield-backup.json kufolda yedatha yayo. Ungavumelanisa leyo folda nge-Syncthing, i-Drive, noma i-USB. Uma emadivayisi lamabili abhala ngesikhatsi sinye, khipha futsi kudivayisi loyithembako bese ungenisa kwenye.
accountHint: Ngekukhetsa. Vumelanisa luhlu lwemuntfu lwekuvimbela/lwekuthemba kuphela emkhatsini kwewebhusayithi, i-extension, nedeskithophu. Soze kube umlandvo wekuhlola noma ema-URL lagcwele.
accountDisabled: Kuvumelanisa kwe-akhawunti kucinyiwe kule seva (ACCOUNT_SYNC_ENABLED). Sebentisa sipele lesingaphandle kwe-inthanethi ngezasi, noma cela umsebeni kutsi akuvule kuvumelanisa.
accountMagicSent: Uma lelo likheli lingamukela iposi, sixhumanisi sekungena sithunyelwe (kutfutfukisa kungabonisa sixhumanisi ngezasi).
accountSyncToggleHint: Uma kuvuliwe, lokutsi Vumelanisa nyalo kucindzetela futsi kudvonsa i-shield-lists-v1. Kuphuma akusuli luhlu lwelifu.
accountStagingPlaceholder: Namathisela i-JSON ye-shield-lists-v1 kucindzetela, noma Vumelanisa nyalo kudvonsa.
accountDeleteConfirm: Sula le akhawunti kanye nesitfombe seluhlu lwelifu? Loku akukwati kubuyiselwa. Luhlu lwendzawo ku-extension/ideskithophu aluthintwa.
accountSignOutNote: Kuphuma akusuli luhlu lwelifu. Kusula i-akhawunti kuyakwenta loko.
accountOfflineBackup: Sipele lesingaphandle kwe-inthanethi: khipha noma ngenisa i-JSON noma i-QR ye-shield-lists-v1 kusuka ku-extension noma ku-app yedeskithophu.
accountSyncNeedPrivacy: Khetsa Le divayisi kuphela noma Kuhlola emaphutsa kwekulekelela ngaphambi kwekuvumelanisa kulungiselela kweluhlu kule sayithi.
accountSyncEmpty: Kute luhlu lwelifu okwanyalo — namathisela i-JSON bese ucindzetela kuVumelanisa nyalo kulayisha.
accountListsTooMany: Kunetinhlamvu letinyenti kakhulu tekuvimbela/tekuthemba kuvumelanisa kwelifu.
accountListsTooLarge: I-JSON yeluhlu idlula umkhawulo wosayizi welifu.
blockListsPrivacySurfaces: Ku-Ungagcini nhlobo: i-extension isula luhlu lwemuntfu ku-chrome.storage; i-app yedeskithophu iyabuta ngaphambi kwekusula i-shield-backup.json kudiski.
blockListsLiveDeepLink: Kuvimbela nekuthemba kusebenta ku-extension / ideskithophu — vula emadokhumenti ekufaka
leaveAndBlockSettingsCta: Vula Tinhlelo — luhlu lwekuvimbela lusebenta ku-extension / ideskithophu
ambiguousProbeNotPhishing: Kuvinjelwa kwe-bot noma kuncishiswa kwenhlolo akusibo bufakazi bekukhwabanisa — vula isayithi kusiphequluli lesijwayelekile uma usayidzinga.
probeBlocked403Detail: Kutfole i-HTTP 403 (Forbidden). Isayithi yenqabile loku kuhlola lokwenzakalelayo — loko akusibo bufakazi bekukhwabanisa. Zama likheli kusiphequluli lesijwayelekile uma kudzingeka.
probeBlocked429Detail: Kutfole i-HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests). Isayithi inciphise loku kuhlola — loko akusibo bufakazi bekukhwabanisa. Linda bese uzama futsi, noma vula likheli kusiphequluli lesijwayelekile.
probeBlocked503Detail: Kutfole i-HTTP 503 (Service Unavailable). Isayithi noma umkhawulo ungase ugcwale — loko akusibo bufakazi bekukhwabanisa. Zama futsi ngekuhamba kwesikhatsi kusiphequluli lesijwayelekile uma kudzingeka.
personalListLeaveNote: Kuphuma kuphakanyiswe luhlu lwakho lwemuntfu lwekuvimbela (i-extension / ideskithophu). Le webhusayithi ayilugcinanga luhlu.
settingsIntro: Kukhetsa kwekuvikela lokungabuyiselwa lokugcinwe kulesi siphequluli kuphela. Kuhlola tinsongo kusetjentiswa luhlu lwe-buusdo uqobo — ema-URL awathunyelwa etinsitweni tedumela tenkhampani yesitsatfu.
timingTimeout: Inhlolo iphelelwe sikhatsi. I-CHECK_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS lephakanyisiwe: {suggested} (yanyalo {current}; inhlolo lephelelwe sikhatsi lephezulu {observed}).

historyFilterProbeBlockedEmpty: Kute kuhlola kwenhlolo lokuvinjelwe emlandvweni wakamuva.

intelMergePtWriteSessionOnly: Simo sekuhlanganisa sisetjentiswe kulesi sikhatsi. Kubhala ku-.env.local kunqatshelwe (i-vinext ingase ikuvimbele) — kusetjentiswa kweqa kwesikhatsi sekusebenta / ifayela lekubuyela.
intelMergePtWriteFallbackPath: Simo sekuhlanganisa sisetjentiswe ngaleso sikhatsi. I-.env.local inqatshelwe — igcinwe ku-{path}.
blockOnSurfaces: Kuvimbela kuqhuba ku-extension yesiphequluli naku-app yedeskithophu — hhayi kule webhusayithi. Isayithi ihlola emakheli kuphela. Bheka Tinhlelo ngemadokhumenti ekufaka.

historyNoHeadFails: Kute kwehluleka kwe-HEAD lokuphindzekile ekuhloleni kwakamuva.

historyNote: Sizinda, lizinga lebungoti, i-ms yenhlolo nekuphelelwa sikhatsi kuphela — soze kube likheli leligcwele. Kusulwa uma iDatha iku-Ungagcini nhlobo.
historyTimeoutHostsNote: Kuphelelwa sikhatsi lokuphindzekile lapha kuvame kusho khuphula i-CHECK_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS, noma umshini uvimbela kuhlola lokwenzakalelayo. I-CSV yesifinyezo sekuphelelwa sikhatsi ifaka ikholomu ye-probeBlocked (linani lekuhlola lokuvinjelwe kwe-403/429/503 ngemshini — soze kube i-URL legcwele).
historyExportCsvHelp: Emakholomu e-CSV yesifinyezo sekuphelelwa sikhatsi: domain, timeouts, checks, max/last probe ms, budget, headFails, headSkips, probeBlocked.
historyNoTimeouts: Kute kuphelelwa sikhatsi kwenhlolo ekuhloleni kwakamuva.

feedbackDraftsAfterReport: Ngemuva kombhalo wesikhashana wekubika i-Misa: khomba luhlu ngezasi, khipha i-batches/*.json, bese umsebeni usebentisa i-npm run threat:apply. Akukho lokuthunyelwa kulesi siphequluli.

evidenceRedirectChainDetail: Sicelo silandele kudluliswa lokukodvwa noma ngaphezulu.
evidenceTlsFailDetail: I-HTTPS ayikwati kucinisekiswa. Ungafaki lwati lolubucayi.
evidenceIpHostDetail: Isayithi ifinyelelwa nge-IP esikhundleni segama lesizinda lelijwayelekile.
evidenceRiskyTldDetail: Lesi sipheto sisetjentiswa kakhulu emikhankasweni yekukhwabanisa. Sodvwa asifakazeli umonakalo.

evidenceSecretQueryDetail: Likheli libeka imfihlo ku-query. Linani aligciniwe.
